posts.title: Techno Marching Band!
posts.description: When someone says “German techno group”, you probably have a pretty good picture in your mind. MEUTE , on the other hand, is an 11-piece techno marching band that plays electronic music with acoustic instruments: tubas, trombones, drum kits, etc. Reset (above) is a single from their new album, KOSMOS. I love this. Via Kottke Their full performance live on KEXP is worth a watch too.
